operations.name: Russel Milton Wills

expected.charges: Refusal of military induction following draft-card destruction — February 24, 1966
expected.convicted: Yes — convicted and sentenced September 23, 1966; affirmed on appeal
expected.sentence: Five years in federal prison, later reduced to two years. Service at McNeil Island is verified; exact custody endpoints remain unresolved.

updates.prosecutor: Michael Swafford; Eugene G. Cushing (government counsel on appeal)

operations.source: Primary United States v. Wills,384 F.2d943(9thCir1967): https://law.justia.com/cases/federal/appellate-courts/F2/384/943/393110/ . Qualified appellate counsel only; circuit judges not assigned as trial judge. No exact admission or release found.

operations.name: DeCourcy Squire

expected.name: DeCourcy Squire
expected.description: A Quaker antiwar activist and former Antioch College student from Cincinnati, known for a lengthy jail hunger strike (Dec 1967-Jan 1968) after an earlier arrest. One of the eight arrested Sept 6, 1970 in the Rochester raids; convicted and sentenced to twenty to thirty months by Judge Harold Burke. She later became a physical therapist and a lifelong war-tax resister and anti-hunger organizer (Just Harvest).

operations.source: Antioch College,175th anniversary history, named DeCourcy Squire Headshot and adjacent biographical identification: https://antiochcollege.edu/history/ . Original asset https://antiochcollege.edu/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/DeCourcy-Squire-headshot.jpeg . Photographer uncredited; no open license asserted. Original downloaded without cropping or alteration. Existing biography preserved.
